node.title: Re: Variable-Width Lookbehind (hacked via recursion)
node.author: vr
node.doctext:
Nice trick :-). Perhaps looking ahead only to immediately look back isn't necessary? (Same for other regexen, + all tests are OK):

my $re1 = qr{ (? x (? \d+ ) (?!\d) ) (? (?<= (?! (? ab \g{digits} (?!\d) ) ) . (?=(?&lookback)) . | (?=(?&match)) . . ) ) }msx;
